R596.note: Removes @csrf_exempt (and its import) so CsrfViewMiddleware protects the POST again; the 401/405 paths and the queue_change call are byte-identical.

R597.note: bin2hex(random_bytes(32)) is the correct CSPRNG replacement; the client_seed drop and the token becoming a 64-char hex string are inherent to the fix and both stated.

R598.note: ValidAlgorithms = new[]{"HS256"} pins the algorithm as the finding requires and matches the SymmetricSecurityKey; the explanation's asymmetric-key-confusion rationale is off for this configuration but the code is right.

R599.note: Adds toRealPath() containment on the created parent, which closes the symlinked-directory escape the textual normalize()/startsWith() check misses, and createDirectories makes nested entries extract as the contract requires; only side effect is that empty dirs may be created before an escaping entry is rejected.

R600.note: getCanonicalPath() containment against the canonical base plus separator closes traversal and symlink escape for a flat store; the added leading-'/' reject and the retained double decode do not block a legitimate flat filename.

R601.note: The /bin/ls branch is closed by the argument array, but the Windows branch still runs cmd.exe /c: Java's ProcessImpl only quotes args containing space/tab/</> for a non-.bat image, so data like 'x&whoami' is passed unquoted and cmd re-parses '&' - injection survives on Windows.

R602.note: Parameterized QueryRow with a ? placeholder; query shape, scan, 404 path and output format unchanged, and the placeholder-dialect caveat is stated.

R603.note: Generic 500 body with the wrapped error routed to log.Printf; the only observable change is the response text, which is the fix itself.

R604.note: Chains .RequireAuthorization() onto the MapDelete, the per-endpoint metadata that was missing; nothing else in Program.cs is touched.

R605.note: Rejecting CR/LF before the socket write closes the IMAP command-injection vector and rejects nothing a real mailbox name can contain; a missing 'folder' param now NPEs instead of sending 'SELECT null', both being failure paths.

R606.note: Plain CsrfTokenRequestAttributeHandler is Spring's documented SPA pairing for the raw cookie value, keeping validation enforced; it omits setCsrfRequestAttributeName(null)/a cookie filter, so the token is still deferred and the XSRF-TOKEN cookie is not issued on safe requests, but that is no worse than the original.

R607.note: Canonical-base containment plus the single-component check closes the traversal, but it adds restrictions the original accepted - any filename with a separator (a nested path under TESTFILES_DIR) is now rejected, and dropping URLDecoder means a percent-encoded cookie value writes a differently named file; both are stated but still change what legitimate callers get.

R608.note: Secure closes the reported vector; HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax are stated hardening against other weaknesses and block no legitimate use of a server-read session cookie.

R609.note: FromSqlInterpolated binds both tenantId and the pre-built %term% pattern as parameters; contains-style matching, async List<Product> return and the empty-term behaviour are all preserved.
